**Chinese name:** 芯海科技（深圳）股份有限公司 (Xīnhǎi Kējī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The TI/ADI-substitution test case for precision analog: its PC EC/SuperIO chips sit in domestic AI-PCs (Honor Book Pro 14, Intel PCL) — a quiet sovereign-PC node — and Q2 2026 delivered the first profitable quarter (¥623k) after a three-year high-end transition; FY2025 revenue ¥8.49亿 (+20.8%), still loss-making.
:::

## What does this firm design?

High-precision ADC/AFE, health-sensing and haptic SoCs, PC embedded controllers and PD/BMS, MCUs.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2003 |
| **Location** | Shenzhen, Guangdong |
| **Product Focus** | Precision ADC/AFE + MCU platform: health-sensing SoCs (BIA/PPG), force-touch HMI SoCs, PC embedded controllers (EC/SuperIO/PD, Thunderbolt), BMS, HarmonyOS ecosystem chips |
| **Node Sophistication** | Mature mixed-signal (55/40nm-class typical, undisclosed); 24-bit ADC measuring ~21nV |
| **Entity List** | No |
